tools.name: find_suburb
tools.description: Look up a published Australian suburb by name or postcode and get its SuburbScanner id and page. Use the id with get_suburb_local_context and search_major_projects. Returns up to 10 matches.

tools.name: get_suburb_local_context
tools.description: Open government data for one published suburb: major projects that government registers list within 10 km (status, cost, timing, register link), new dwellings approved and estimated population for the ABS statistical area (SA2) it sits in, and its SA2, SA3 and SA4. tools.name: search_major_projects
tools.description: Search the major infrastructure, resources and energy projects that Australian government registers list as planned or under way. Filter by state, kind, minimum published cost, or distance from a published suburb. Status, cost and timing are each register's own; every row links to its register.

tools.name: get_market_breadth
tools.description: National and state statistics on Australian residential asking prices over the latest three months: the share of reliably measured suburb markets with a lower median asking price, the median change, and the same for gross yields, houses and units separately. tools.name: calculate_holding_cost
tools.description: Pre-tax weekly cost or surplus of holding an Australian investment property at a given price and weekly rent, on the user's own loan and cost assumptions, plus the break-even rent and break-even interest rate. Arithmetic only: it uses no market data and is not advice.

tools.name: price_change_as_rate_change
tools.description: Restate a change in a property's price as the interest-rate change that would move the loan repayment by the same amount (for example, how many rate rises a 10% lower price offsets). Arithmetic on the user's own numbers; not a forecast or advice.

tools.name: about_suburbscanner_data
tools.description: What the SuburbScanner connector covers, where each piece comes from, its licence and how to credit it, and what it does not include. Use before quoting figures.
